subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Reconhecer as variedades da língua falada, o conceito de norma-padrão e o de preconceito linguístico.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer a existência de variedades da linguagem oral em diferentes contextos sociais e regionais
components.description_en: Recognize the existence of varieties of spoken language across different social and regional contexts
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between formal and informal speech registers across different contexts and tasks

components.description_pt: Definir o conceito de norma padrão como uma referência linguística socialmente construída
components.description_en: Define the concept of the standard norm as a socially constructed linguistic reference

components.description_pt: Identificar exemplos de preconceito linguístico e explicar sua base social
components.description_en: Identify examples of linguistic prejudice and explain its social basis
components.cc_component_description: Identify loaded language in a historical or social studies text and explain what it reveals about the author's purpose

cc_matches.description: Adapt speech to a variety of contexts and tasks, demonstrating command of formal English when indicated or appropriate.
Identify aspects of a text that reveal an author's point of view or purpose (e.g., loaded language, inclusion or avoidance of particular facts).
